message:
Running command: cd /workspace && sed -n '1,220p' README.md && printf '
--- submit.sh ---
' && sed -n '1,220p' submit.sh && printf '
--- files ---
' && find . -maxdepth 2 \( -name 'poc*' -o -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.py' \) | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200
